prompts: Use case: logo-brand. Create one finished square logo image for the business Spraggins Designs, owned by Austin Spraggins in Fresno, California. Brand research: spragginsdesigns.xyz uses near-black charcoal, vivid cyan/turquoise, white, bold geometric sans serif type. Austin builds websites for local businesses plus production AI systems, apps and games; skilled and approachable independent creative engineer. This is a real usable business logo graphic, NOT a photo of a fictitious physical storefront, NOT a mockup, NOT a multi-option presentation sheet. High-end original identity design with optical balance, exceptional typography, crisp precise edges. Exact business name only: "SPRAGGINS" and "DESIGNS". Spell SPRAGGINS correctly S P R A G G I N S. No other copy, no URL, no slogan, no watermark, no concept numbering. Square composition with generous safe margins; all essential artwork inside central 75 percent so it survives common profile crops. Large legible wordmark. Render at high resolution. Direction 1: PRECISION SD. On an absolutely flat near-black #121212 background, design a distinctive compact interlocking SD monogram in vivid cyan #5ce1e6, combining two substantial geometric ribbon shapes with a clever clean negative-space join. Architectural, timeless, confident, instantly readable, few shapes, no circuitry or decorative particles. Mark centered in upper-middle, then SPRAGGINS in bold white geometric sans serif on one line and DESIGNS in smaller but clearly readable cyan widely spaced capitals centered underneath. Refined Swiss-design proportions, premium software design studio identity. Flat vector-style fills, no glow, no gradients, no 3D or shadows.
